rules.title: Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance (relocation assistance for owner move-in evictions)
rules.requirement: Owners must pay tenants relocation assistance in an owner move-in eviction; the Ellis Implementation Ordinance requires the same payments when a property is withdrawn from the rental market. Payments are indexed to inflation and the Rent Board publishes the yearly increase.
rules.key_value: Standard payment $19,413; additional payment for qualifying households $6,471 (1.5% CPI increase, effective 1 Jan 2026)
rules.citation: Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance; Ellis Implementation Ordinance
rules.status_basis: Existing ordinances in force; page announces the annual adjustment effective January 1, 2026 (annual figure, not the law's effective date).
rules.quoted_span: The Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance requires owners to pay tenants relocation assistance in the event of an owner move-in eviction. The Ellis Implementation Ordinance requires the same relocation assistance payments for tenants evicted so the owner can remove a property from the rental housing market.
